prompt: Analyze ibuprofen as a drug candidate and tell me if it has good drug-likeness properties.

assertions.name: includes_qed_score
assertions.check: Output contains QED score (Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness)

assertions.name: includes_lipinski
assertions.check: Output mentions Lipinski's Rule of Five and indicates violations

assertions.name: includes_overall_assessment
assertions.check: Output provides a conclusion or recommendation about drug potential

assertions.name: uses_open_biomed_tools
assertions.check: Analysis uses the open_biomed tools (TOOLS dictionary, molecule_name_request, etc.)

assertions.name: structured_format
assertions.check: Output uses tables, sections, or structured format for clarity
